metadata.description: Golden hour on any water, Venice's lagoon first, in one light: the water shaded inside its shores from jade flats to navy channels and sea, and where a low sun lies on it, darker at the path's edges and lifting through dusk plum and amber to white-gold on its axis, narrow at the horizon and broad and soft toward the viewer; glitter where fine moving noise peaks, stretched into short dashes, few near the camera and dense toward the horizon, where it pierces the haze in a hot line under a red-rimmed sun the horizon cuts; caustics in the shallows fading away from the sun; foam inside the shores; on warm stone, terracotta roofs over their shadows, sage gardens and pale squares, warmer toward the sun's axis and cooler and darker toward the view's edges; a warm haze lit about the sun; in flatter views, plain water under a soft sheen and a few fine sparkles; names chosen by class, rank and zoom.
